title: Enable hiding more stuff
body:
Added options to:
- Hide Bookmark Counts
- Modify "Hide All Grok" to hide the bottom-left drawer
- Hide Home, Lists, Bookmarks, Profile, "More" and Everything in the Left Sidebar
- Hide Left / Right / Both Sidebars
- Hide Message Drawer
- Hide User Info / User Avatar / User Handle
- Hide Premium Badge

Copied changes to Chromium extension, successfully tested on latest Brave (couldn't successfully test on Chromium because Debian's version is too old).
author: precompute

title: Memetic Immunity in BlueRaven?
body:
This might not be aligned with your goals for BlueRaven at all: feel free to close without elaboration if so

But what are your thoughts on implementing a simple LLM Twitter post filter, based on a user-defined list of muted concepts? It's insufficient as a long-term solution but perhaps if people start testing basic layers of defense like this, it'd provide empirical insight on the kinds of challenges involved in handling increasingly aggressive memes

I'm not familiar with the current state of usable WebGPU model perf but perhaps small classifiers would be feasible to run efficiently. Even if it's something absurd like 500ms latency, one day it'll be obviously preferable to living with no immune system at all, so it could make sense to start iterating sooner rather than later
author: michaelskyba
